data_fields.name: bag_slots_per_bag
data_fields.donor_constant: def.bagSlots (per bag item; 6 to 14 in the migration ladder)

best_idea: One stack-merge predicate serves both the capacity check and the grant, and any batch or craft is checked on a scratch copy before a real slot changes.
decision_why: Keep the single predicate, the scratch-copy batch check and the consume-then-fit check for crafting; drop the materials-only pool (no material taxonomy in Frankendom's rulings) and do not copy the grant overflow tolerance without a written rule.
acceptance: A server test with 16 slots, 15 of them full 20-stacks of one item: a grant of 20 copies is accepted, a grant of 21 is refused with a bag-full result, and a craft whose input empties a slot succeeds when its output needs that slot, while the same craft without the input fails.
